# SparklyTurf

## About
SparklyTurf is a professional artificial turf cleaning company that specializes in eliminating pet odors, stains, and bacteria from synthetic grass. We use eco-friendly, non-toxic, and pet-safe solutions.

## Services
- Deep Turf Cleaning: Full extraction of urine, dirt, dust, and debris
- Odor Treatment: Enzymatic solutions that destroy odor-causing bacteria
- Stain Removal: Gentle cleaners and brushing techniques
- Pet Waste Removal: Complete sanitization
- Pet Hair Removal: Specialized tools and vacuums
- Infill Replacement: Premium cooling, odor-absorbing materials
- Turf Restoration: Power washing, re-fluffing, drainage improvement

## Pricing Plans
- Quarterly (every 3 months): $359/service, 10% off
- Bi-Monthly (every 2 months): $319/service, 20% off
- Monthly: $279/service, 30% off

## How It Works
1. Request a free quote with your turf dimensions and concerns
2. Schedule a cleaning at a convenient time
3. Our team deep cleans your turf using eco-friendly methods

## Guarantee
100% satisfaction guaranteed. If not satisfied, we re-clean at no cost.
